resources.string: Import a ZIP package to begin.
Choose a signed ZIP package for your dimmer. You can update without saving a registry record.
Keep the dimmer powered and stay nearby with the phone. In Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT, select this dimmer and use Start Bluetooth recovery.
If Android requests pairing, enter 824005 and wait for the result here. Choose Resume only if the operation is interrupted.
Check Bluetooth reads the connection and installed images. It does not upload firmware, send resets, or change the update checkpoint.

Bluetooth address: %1$s
Hardware UID: %2$s
ZIP SHA-256: %3$s
Firmware SHA-256: %4$s
Migration image: %5$s
Check that this dimmer is online in Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT, then record the result here. Bluetooth disconnecting alone does not confirm a successful restart.

The dimmer may already have restarted, but the app did not receive acknowledgement. Resume checks the firmware first. If needed, you authorize one additional restart attempt. An internal copy or reset already started cannot be cancelled.
Stop prevents further requests and preserves saved progress. An internal copy or restart already started may still finish.
Bluetooth permissions granted. You can check the connection, start an update, or resume.
Bluetooth permission was denied. Choose Allow Bluetooth or enable Nearby devices in Android app settings, then retry.
Choose Allow Bluetooth, then retry the operation.
The app is preparing. Wait a moment and retry.
Report saved to your selected file. You can share it for diagnosis.
Choose the package for your device.
Wait while saved data is checked.
You confirmed the dimmer returned online in Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT. The report records your observation.
Allow Bluetooth discovery and connections to reach this dimmer. No update starts automatically.
Stay near the powered dimmer. Use Start Bluetooth recovery in Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT. Android pairing code: 824005. Gesture entry depends on the installed firmware.

The phone connects only to the dimmer bound to this signed legacy package. Complete pairing in the Android dialog and wait for the result here. Check Bluetooth reads images without installing firmware. Use Resume after an interrupted update. Ordinary Bluetooth sessions on supporting firmware show blue / green and return to Zigbee after 60 seconds idle. Other independent recovery entries show blue / red and remain active. Hold both buttons for 5 seconds to request a safe Zigbee return on supporting firmware.
The selected dimmer changed. Check the name before continuing.
Import did not start. Select the ZIP package again.
No report is available yet. Run a Bluetooth check or an update first.
